extraction.name: MVBench
extraction.description: A comprehensive Multi-modal Video understanding Benchmark
extraction.creator: Kunchang Li, Yali Wang, Yinan He, Yizhuo Li, Yi Wang, Yi Liu, Zun Wang, Jilan Xu, Guo Chen, Ping Luo, Limin Wang, Yu Qiao
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset is collected from public video benchmarks, including STAR, PAXION, Moments in Time V1, FunQA, CLEVRER, Perception Test, Charades-STA, MoVQA, NTU RGB+D, VLN-CE, and TVQA.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Web Scraping, Secondary Data analysis, Document analysis
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Videos are collected from 11 public video datasets that cover a broad spectrum of domains and scenes.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Videos are filtered and relevant multiple-choice QAs are auto-generated using LLMs.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Annotations are generated using ChatGPT based on task definitions.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset has limitations in terms of data generalization limits and quality issues.
